rules.title: Allowable Rent Increase for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: Rent increases are limited to 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.summary_plain: Your landlord can only increase your rent by up to 1.6% between March 1, 2026 and February 28, 2027.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su arrendador solo puede aumentar su renta hasta un 1.6% entre el 1 de marzo de 2026 y el 28 de febrero de 2027.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental units covered by San Francisco rent control ordinances.
rules.exemptions_text: Certain units may be exempt under San Francisco rent control laws, such as new construction or owner-occupied units.
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Ordinance, Admin. Code Chapter 37
rules.quoted_span: Allowable Rent Increase: 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Rate for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: Security deposits must accrue interest at a rate of 4.2% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.summary_plain: Your landlord must pay you 4.2% interest on your security deposit for the period from March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su arrendador debe pagarle un interés del 4.2% sobre su depósito de seguridad para el período del 1 de marzo de 2026 al 28 de febrero de 2027.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to security deposits held on rental units covered by San Francisco rent control ordinances.
rules.exemptions_text: Certain exemptions may apply under San Francisco rent control laws.
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Ordinance, Admin. Code Chapter 37
rules.quoted_span: Security Deposit Interest: 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
